en: Vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard titled "Bușteni" showing the mountain resort of Bușteni with views of the Bucegi Mountains and a snowy chalet. The reverse has a Romanian 40 bani stamp ("ANIVERSARI CULTURALE" – Aron Pumnul, 1966), Romanian-language handwriting, and postal cancellations from Bușteni and București dated 1967. Publisher credit "Editura Meridiane" and price "Lei 1" appear on the back.
